The '''Ryloth system''' was [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Gaulus sector/Legends|Gaulus sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] which contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]].
